payload.posture: Read John 20:1–10 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states mary sees the removed stone and reports; Peter and the other disciple run, enter in different order, inspect the linen, and return. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
